name: Thingport
short_desc: Self-hosted 3D model library with OpenSCAD script customizer and MakerWorld/Printables/Thingiverse imports
author: Tautvydas Deržinskas
description: Thingport is a self-hosted 3D model library with 3D previews, tags, collections, print profiles and versioning. It imports models and synced collections from MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse, MyMiniFactory and 19 more sites, normalizes MakerWorld 3MF files for Cura/PrusaSlicer, and ships built-in tools and generators — including an OpenSCAD **script customizer** that regenerates a model from its .scad source with sliders, dropdowns and text fields (a self-hosted equivalent of MakerWorld's Customizer). Optional AI features (descriptions, categorization, CAD studio) work with a local model or Claude and are disabled by default. First registered account becomes the admin.
